decisions.reason: The separate internal-link clause is already represented by a complete same-message MODIFY; the image-count change requires no additional update to this Requirement.
The specified image count changes the blog-image Requirement but does not alter the existing article count, delivery window, or publication workflow.
The number of images in an article does not change its selected keywords or keyword-replacement rule.
The image-count decision does not change the workflow for supplying or selecting blog topics.
The campaign keyword count and selected replacement keyword are independent of blog image quantity.
The webpage replacement text is unrelated to the number of pictures required in blog articles.
The blog image requirement does not alter backlink quantity or follow-type percentages.
Requiring 3-4 pictures in a blog does not establish or modify whether those images require ALT attributes; the overlap is only the shared concept of images.
